dataset_name: Digital Krishna Public Scripture Schema Example
purpose: Demonstrates the scripture record structure used by the DSOC prototype.
important_notice: This sample is not automatically connected to the guidance API. Scripture content must receive appropriate review before being presented as verified.

records.original_text: कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन । मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि ॥

translation.text: Focus on the work that is yours to perform rather than becoming controlled by its result.

records.teaching_summary: Responsible effort should receive more attention than anxiety about outcomes.
